title: Care wishes
content:
SYNTHETIC. Care wishes of Mai Tran (fictional), written 3 March 2026 while lucid.
1. I want to stay at home as long as two carers a day can manage it.
2. If I no longer recognise Linh or Long, do not start dialysis or tube feeding.
3. Pain relief before alertness, always.
4. Linh decides medical questions. Long decides money questions. Neither decides alone about selling the house.
5. My friend Thu knows where the photo albums are.
6. Tell the grandchildren the truth, gently.
